        try:

            rseq=tb.sequence(chrom,rs,re)

        # For each A: L=s-A+4; window pos p=-w..w => coordinate L+p. Index in lseq: (L+p)-ls = s-A+4+p - (s-40)=44-A+p

import gzip, py2bit, numpy as np, sys, time, os
frag='unknown.shift.frag.bed.gz'
tb=py2bit.open('hg38.2bit')
valid=set(tb.chroms())
chromlen=tb.chroms()
bases='ACGT'
Amin,Amax=-20,20
Bmin,Bmax=-20,20
w=15
Avals=list(range(Amin,Amax+1))
Bvals=list(range(Bmin,Bmax+1))
left_counts=np.zeros((len(Avals),2*w+1,4),dtype=np.float64)
right_counts=np.zeros((len(Bvals),2*w+1,4),dtype=np.float64)
# mapping
base_idx=np.zeros(256,dtype=np.int8); base_idx[:]=-1
for i,b in enumerate(bases): base_idx[ord(b)]=i
n=skipped=0
t=time.time()
with gzip.open(frag,'rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        chrom=parts[0]
        if chrom not in valid:
            skipped+=1; continue
        clen=chromlen[chrom]
        s=int(parts[1]); e=int(parts[2])
        ls=s-60; le=s+70  # broad enough for A range -20..20 and window +-15: L min s-16, max s+24 -> window min s-31 max s+39, so 60/70 fine
        # actually A min -20 L=s+24; max A=20 L=s-16; window max s+39 min s-31. Good.
        rs=e-70; re=e+60
        def getseq(chrom, st, en):
            # returns padded sequence length en-st centered
            if en<=st: return 'N'*(en-st)
            qs=max(st,0); qe=min(en,clen)
            seq=''
            if qs<qe:
                seq=tb.sequence(chrom,qs,qe).upper()
            padleft='N'*(qs-st)
            padright='N'*(en-qe)
            return padleft+seq+padright
        lseq=getseq(chrom,ls,le)
        rseq=getseq(chrom,rs,re)
        # vectorized positions for left
        # left base index in lseq = (L+p)-ls = (s-A+4+p)-ls; ls=s-60 => 64-A+p (for p -w..w)
        start_idx_l=64-w
        arr=np.frombuffer(lseq.encode('ascii'),dtype=np.uint8).copy()
        arr=base_idx[arr]
        for ia,A in enumerate(Avals):
            si=start_idx_l-A
            sub=arr[si:si+2*w+1]
            # count
            for p,b in enumerate(sub):
                if b>=0:
                    left_counts[ia,p,b]+=1
        start_idx_r=65-w  # R=e-B-5, rs=e-70 => index=R+p-rs=65-B+p
        arr=np.frombuffer(rseq.encode('ascii'),dtype=np.uint8).copy()
        arr=base_idx[arr]
        for ib,B in enumerate(Bvals):
            si=start_idx_r-B
            sub=arr[si:si+2*w+1]
            for p,b in enumerate(sub):
                if b>=0:
                    right_counts[ib,p,b]+=1
        n+=1
        if n%20000==0:
            print('processed',n,'time',time.time()-t, file=sys.stderr)
print('total',n,'skipped',skipped, file=sys.stderr)
# score KL vs uniform; also compute entropy
bg=np.array([0.25]*4)
def scorekl(counts):
    totals=counts.sum(axis=2,keepdims=True)
    freq=counts/np.maximum(totals,1e-12)
    return (freq*np.log((freq+1e-12)/(bg+1e-12))).sum(axis=2).sum(axis=1)
def score_ent(counts):
    totals=counts.sum(axis=2,keepdims=True)
    freq=counts/np.maximum(totals,1e-12)
    ent=-(freq*np.log2(freq+1e-12)).sum(axis=2)
    return ent.sum(axis=1) # lower more biased
print('LEFT KL')
for A,sc in zip(Avals,scorekl(left_counts)): print(f'{A}\\t{sc:.4f}')
print('LEFT ENT')
for A,sc in zip(Avals,score_ent(left_counts)): print(f'{A}\\t{sc:.4f}')
print('RIGHT KL')
for B,sc in zip(Bvals,scorekl(right_counts)): print(f'{B}\\t{sc:.4f}')
print('RIGHT ENT')
for B,sc in zip(Bvals,score_ent(right_counts)): print(f'{B}\\t{sc:.4f}')
np.savez('shift_counts.npz', Avals=Avals,Bvals=Bvals,left_counts=left_counts,right_counts=right_counts)
tb.close()

import gzip, py2bit, numpy as np, pandas as pd, time, sys
frag='unknown.shift.frag.bed.gz'
tb=py2bit.open('hg38.2bit')
valid=set(tb.chroms()); chromlen=tb.chroms()
bases='ACGT'
# range
Amin,Amax=-10,10
Bmin,Bmax=-10,10
w=10; W=2*w+1
Avals=np.arange(Amin,Amax+1,dtype=int); Bvals=np.arange(Bmin,Bmax+1,dtype=int)
NA=len(Avals); NB=len(Bvals)
# broad windows
LL=90; RL=90
lstart_off=-40; rend_off=40; rstart_off=-50; lend_off=50
# load fragments
t=time.time()
df=pd.read_csv(frag, sep='\\t', header=None, names=['chrom','start','end','barcode','count'], usecols=['chrom','start','end'], dtype={'chrom':str,'start':int,'end':int})
mask=df['chrom'].isin(valid).values
df=df[mask].reset_index(drop=True)
N=len(df)
print('N',N,'load',time.time()-t, file=sys.stderr)
Larr=np.full((N,LL), -1, dtype=np.int8)
Rarr=np.full((N,RL), -1, dtype=np.int8)
base_idx=np.full(256,-1,dtype=np.int8)
for i,b in enumerate(bases): base_idx[ord(b)]=i
# encode function
def get_codes(chrom, st, en, width):
    clen=chromlen[chrom]
    if en<=st: return np.full(width,-1,dtype=np.int8)
    qs=max(st,0); qe=min(en,clen)
    seq=''
    if qs<qe:
        seq=tb.sequence(chrom,qs,qe).upper()
    # pad with N => code -1
    arr=np.full(width,-1,dtype=np.int8)
    off=qs-st
    # fill Ns already -1, then actual
    arr[off:off+len(seq)] = base_idx[np.frombuffer(seq.encode('ascii'),dtype=np.uint8).copy()]
    return arr
# Loop; use apply? no
for idx,row in df.iterrows():
    s=int(row['start']); e=int(row['end']); chrom=row['chrom']
    Larr[idx]=get_codes(chrom, s+lstart_off, s+lstart_off+LL, LL)
    Rarr[idx]=get_codes(chrom, e+rstart_off, e+rstart_off+RL, RL)
    if (idx+1)%20000==0:
        print('fetched',idx+1,'time',time.time()-t, file=sys.stderr)
print('fetched all',N,'time',time.time()-t, file=sys.stderr)
# counts
def compute_counts(arr, vals, base_start):
    counts=np.zeros((len(vals),W,4),dtype=np.float64)
    for i,v in enumerate(vals):
        si=base_start-v
        sub=arr[:,si:si+W]  # N x W
        for p in range(W):
            col=sub[:,p]
            for b in range(4):
                counts[i,p,b]=np.count_nonzero(col==b)
        if (i+1)%5==0: print('cand',v,'time',time.time()-t, file=sys.stderr)
    return counts
left_counts=compute_counts(Larr, Avals, 44-w)
right_counts=compute_counts(Rarr, Bvals, 45-w)
# scores
def kl(counts):
    bg=np.array([0.25]*4)
    totals=counts.sum(axis=2,keepdims=True)
    freq=counts/np.maximum(totals,1e-12)
    return (freq*np.log((freq+1e-12)/(bg+1e-12))).sum(axis=2).sum(axis=1)
def ent(counts):
    totals=counts.sum(axis=2,keepdims=True)
    freq=counts/np.maximum(totals,1e-12)
    return -(freq*np.log2(freq+1e-12)).sum(axis=2).sum(axis=1)
print('LEFT KL')
for A,sc in zip(Avals,kl(left_counts)): print(f'{A}\\t{sc:.4f}')
print('LEFT ENT')
for A,sc in zip(Avals,ent(left_counts)): print(f'{A}\\t{sc:.4f}')
print('RIGHT KL')
for B,sc in zip(Bvals,kl(right_counts)): print(f'{B}\\t{sc:.4f}')
print('RIGHT ENT')
for B,sc in zip(Bvals,ent(right_counts)): print(f'{B}\\t{sc:.4f}')
np.savez('shift_counts_fast.npz', Avals=Avals,Bvals=Bvals,left_counts=left_counts,right_counts=right_counts)
tb.close()

Wseq=120; off=-60

            for b in range(4):
                m=codes==b
                sc[m]+=logp[p,b]
        scores[i,0]=sc.mean()
        scores[i,1]=sc.std()/np.sqrt(N)

def score_orient(arr, base_shift, rc=False):
